# TraceGuard 1.5.0

Open Scope to search indexed routes and check coverage. Open the Trace Inspector from the Trace toolbar to follow a path through source code, inspect its evidence and save review notes.

The Inspector keeps concurrent AI reports attached to their respective traces. Stop cancels the displayed request. The report includes suggested fixes and regression checks.

Install the VSIX using **Extensions: Install from VSIX**. Java, PHP and Python work offline. The matching JavaScript/TypeScript, C# and Go asset packs support on-demand installation or a private mirror.
